evidence.reason: In the current reconcile_fix_prs, records are skipped only when fix_merged is set; every other fix PR is polled via c.pr_info and pr['state'] is stored. The only state branch is MERGED, and even there a continue occurs when the merge commit is not yet an ancestor of DEFAULT_REF. No CLOSED terminal handling exists, so closed fix PRs (and merged-but-not-ancestor PRs) are polled again on every tick, consuming the shared forge budget indefinitely. This is an implementation defect in the intended bounded forge usage, not a new requirement.
